risks.title: Cybersecurity of online payments
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the first part of the document, with strong language (e.g.: 'fraudulent', 'security', 'malware'). It is stable over time and central to PostePay's business, justifying a critical category.

risks.title: Dependence on mobile devices
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes the use of mobile devices for authentication via Poste ID. The language is preventive but repeated, indicating a real operational risk. Trend is stable, high weight in user experience.

risks.title: Strong authentication and PSD2 compliance
risks.score_rationale: The document details strong authentication (password, OTP, Poste ID), linked to PSD2 regulation. The language is technical and mandatory, indicating clear regulatory dependence. Risk is stable but critical.

risks.title: Third-party access to data
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions third-party access (APIs) since 2019 for balance and transaction data. The language is neutral but the risk is new in the ecosystem. Moderate weight but growing.

risks.title: HTTPS transaction security
risks.score_rationale: The document emphasizes the importance of HTTPS protocol and SSL certificates. The language is preventive and repeated, showing a recurring operational risk. Central in user recommendations.

risks.title: Management of confidential codes
risks.score_rationale: The text frequently reminds users to protect PIN, CVC2, and Poste ID. The language is preventive but based on customer responsibility. Moderate but recurring risk.

risks.title: Customer service availability
risks.score_rationale: Customer service is mentioned with limited hours (8am-8pm), but an automated system outside those hours. The language is informative, but lack of quick access could harm reputation. Moderate risk.

risks.title: Risks related to public Wi-Fi
risks.score_rationale: The text specifically warns against using public Wi-Fi networks for payments. The language is clear and preventive, indicating a real technical risk. Prominent in recommendations.
